$description: Demo snippets that show a COMPOSITION rather than a port. A handful of components are deliberately not on the native platforms (components.manifest.json lists them, with the reason for each). Their component pages still carry a native tab, because the useful answer to 'how do I do this on Android?' is the composition those libraries expect — not an empty tab. That is legitimate, but a reader has to be told, because an undeclared native tab is indistinguishable from a claim that the component was ported. Declaring it here is what lets scripts/check-platform-code.mjs tell the two apart, and what lets the component page label the tab honestly. Every symbol in these snippets is still checked against the real package.

avatar-group-demo.reason: AvatarGroup re-wraps its children, which no native layout system does idiomatically. The snippet shows the overlapping row of KinetixAvatars to build instead.

combobox-demo.reason: Combobox is a recipe over Command on the web, not a component anywhere. The snippet shows the native equivalent: a filtered list in a popover, or the platform's own picker.

form-demo.reason: Form is react-hook-form glue with no native analogue. KinetixField and its Label/Description/Message slots already are the equivalent, which is what the snippet shows.

kanban-board-demo.reason: KanbanBoard is built on @dnd-kit's accessible multi-container drag and drop, which has no equivalent dependency natively. The snippet shows each platform's own drag primitive.

native-select-demo.reason: NativeSelect wraps the browser's own <select>, a web-only escape hatch. KinetixSelect already wraps each native platform's own picker, which is what the snippet shows.

navigation-menu-demo.reason: NavigationMenu is a hover-triggered desktop mega-menu with no touch idiom. The snippet shows the platform's own navigation container instead.

tour-demo.reason: Tour targets an arbitrary rendered element by CSS selector; no native platform has an equivalent live-tree query. The snippet shows a sequence of anchored popovers instead.
